prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Holmium (Ho) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a dim colour-grading suite of her element's kingdom — a large calibrated screen, a control desk of dials and a soft bias light
Outfit: a colourist look fitted to her body — a cropped knit top, a short skirt and ankle boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance; she is seen through window glass with faint reflections on it.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small colour calibration chart at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: legs crossed at the knee.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.
Scene note: she is the film colourist matching every shot to the same true tone

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — holmium: a soft silvery metal named for Holmia, the Latin name of Stockholm, after unknown sharp absorption lines first seen in 1878 in Geneva as 'element X'; it has the strongest magnetic moment of any natural element, so pole pieces made with it and iron gather the field of the most powerful magnets into one point; holmium oxide glass, with its sharp dark absorption bands, is the standard every spectrometer is calibrated against, looks pale straw yellow in daylight and turns pink under fluorescent light, and holmium lasers break up kidney stones — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
